summary: Estonian crypto lending and interest-account platform whose assets were placed under provisional court restraint in April 2023 before CoinLoan OÜ was declared bankrupt on 14 June 2023.
what_happened: CoinLoan operated custodial interest accounts and crypto-backed lending products. On 24 April 2023, an Estonian court prohibited CoinLoan OÜ from disposing of assets without the provisional trustee's consent. The Harju County Court declared the company bankrupt on 14 June 2023 in proceeding 2-23-3290. The trustee later prepared creditor lists, and the court confirmed the creditor list on 10 April 2025. Bankruptcy administration and creditor recovery remained ongoing after that confirmation.
uncertainty_notes: The 2017 launch date remains approximate. Reviewed official notices establish the bankruptcy and creditor-list process but do not establish one final universal recovery percentage or completion date for all creditor classes.
